zh.title: 立院三讀無人機條例　政院稱收到法案後審慎考量
zh.summary: 行政院表示尚未收到無人機條例三讀法案；將就國防與產業需求審慎考量。
body: 針對立法院會於8月27日三讀通過「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」，行政院發言人李慧芝於8月30日表示，行政院目前尚未收到三讀法案。收到法案後，行政院將審視相關內容是否符合國防自主及產業發展的需求，並就執行層面進行審慎考量。
該條例明定中央政府應循年度預算程序，連續6年編列總額2400億元預算，原則上每年編列400億元。媒體報導稱行政院將副署該條例並擬於今年度追加預算編列相關費用。李慧芝強調，政府將依據國防戰略儘速編列預算及進行無人載具採購，同時提升關鍵技術自主能力。

en.title: Taiwan Executive Yuan to Review Passed Unmanned Vehicle Act Upon Receipt
en.summary: The Executive Yuan says it will review the newly passed unmanned vehicle act upon receipt in Taipei.
body: Following the passage of the Strengthening National Defense Autonomy and Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Act by Taiwan's Legislative Yuan on August 27, Executive Yuan spokesperson Li Hui-chih stated on August 30 that the executive branch has not yet received the finalized bill. Upon receipt, the Executive Yuan will review whether the legislation aligns with national defense autonomy and industry development needs and will carefully evaluate operational implementation.

The passed bill stipulates that the government should allocate NT$240 billion over six consecutive years for unmanned vehicle development. Addressing media reports regarding countersigning the act and submitting supplementary budget proposals, Li emphasized that the government will expedite budget planning and unmanned vehicle procurements according to defense strategic requirements while enhancing domestic technological autonomy.

zh.title: FlyArystan空中巴士A320在阿拉木圖機場（ALA）維修時起火
zh.summary: FlyArystanA320維修時起火；前起落架艙冒煙；應變人員趕抵處置
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 30 日的報導，FlyArystan 旗下一架空中巴士A320客機（ICAO機型代碼A320），在阿拉木圖機場進行維修作業期間發生起火事件。此起維修期間的起火狀況，發生在該架飛機執行例行維護作業的過程中。
據報導，當時該架空中巴士A320客機的前起落架艙冒出濃煙並出現火光，導致現場正在進行的例行維修工作被迫中斷。在冒煙與火光出現後，現場緊急應變團隊與處置人員迅速趕赴現場展開應變作業。

en.title: FlyArystan Airbus A320 Catches Fire During Maintenance At Almaty Airport (ALA)
en.summary: A FlyArystan Airbus A320 caught fire during maintenance at Almaty Airport as emergency crews responded.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on August 30, 2026, a FlyArystan Airbus A320 aircraft (ICAO type code A320) caught fire while undergoing maintenance at Almaty Airport (ALA). The fire incident occurred as the aircraft was subjected to scheduled routine maintenance procedures on site.

During the maintenance operations, smoke and a visible glow were observed emanating from the aircraft's nose gear bay, which immediately interrupted the ongoing routine servicing work. Following the detection of smoke and fire in the nose gear bay, emergency response crews moved in quickly to address the situation.

zh.title: Airlink客機低空飛越開普敦體育場 飛行追蹤顯示極近距離
zh.summary: Airlink兩架E-Jet客機飛越開普敦體育場；飛行追蹤顯示高度極貼近屋頂
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，兩架由 Airlink 營運的 E-Jet 噴射客機在飛越開普敦體育場（Cape Town Stadium）的過程中，據報機身僅以約 50 英呎的極近高度掠過體育場上方，相關畫面在網路上引發熱議。
根據飛行追蹤資料分析，這兩架噴射客機在飛越過程中的高度讀數與體育場屋頂建築結構之間，呈現出極為狹窄的安全邊際距離。
該項追蹤與分析結果突顯了客機航跡高度與地面體育場屋頂之間的緊密差距，使這起低空飛越事件持續獲得關注。

en.title: Airlink E-Jets Flyover Cape Town Stadium Shows Close Altitude Margins
en.summary: Airlink E-Jets flew over Cape Town Stadium with flight tracking showing narrow clearance above the rooftop.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, two Airlink E-Jets cleared the top of Cape Town Stadium by within 50 feet during a flyover. Video footage of the low-level flight over the stadium went viral across digital platforms shortly after the event occurred.
A detailed analysis of flight tracking data revealed razor-thin margins between the recorded altitude readings of the two jet aircraft and the rooftop of the stadium structure.
The tracking data analysis highlighted the close proximity between the jet aircraft and the Cape Town Stadium facility during the aerial display.

zh.title: FAA擬解僱拉瓜迪亞機場兩航管員 涉致命撞機當晚早退
zh.summary: FAA針對拉瓜迪亞機場航管員早退啟動解僱程序；事故釀兩機師身亡
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）已針對紐約拉瓜迪亞機場（LGA）的兩名空中交通管制員啟動解僱程序。根據調查，這兩名航管員在一起造成兩名機師身亡、數十人受傷的跑道碰撞事故發生當晚，提早約一小時離開工作崗位。
華爾街日報報導指出，這兩名航管員於2026年3月22日班表結束前離去。當時機場因雷雨與延誤導致航班營運受阻，處理的交通流量超過原本排定量的兩倍。兩名航管員提前離職，導致塔台內僅剩兩名航管員在沒有額外人力支援的情況下，應對異常繁忙的空中交通。

該起致命碰撞事故發生於當地時間23時37分。事發時，由 Jazz Aviation 執飛的加拿大航空快捷（Air Canada Express）8646 號班機（機型為 CRJ900 客機）自蒙特婁皮埃爾·埃利奧特·特魯多國際機場（YUL）起飛並降落於拉瓜迪亞機場 4 號跑道，隨後與一輛獲准穿越跑道的機場消防車發生碰撞。該消防車當時正前往應對另一起獨立的飛機緊急狀況。國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）指出，碰撞造成 CRJ900 機師與副機長身亡，另有 39 人送醫治療，其中 6 人受重傷。
美國運輸部長 Sean Duffy 對此類違規行為發表強烈聲明，表示政府絕不容忍欺詐，並將對濫用納稅人資源及增加同事工作負擔的員工採取行動。航管人員稱提前離崗為「早退」（early shove），在 FAA 官員眼中屬於未實際工作卻領取薪資的打卡欺詐行為。全美空中交通管制員協會（NATCA）表示正與 FAA 領導層就廣泛的假勤與打卡欺詐疑慮進行討論，同時也指出航管員長期在艱困的人力條件下工作。

en.title: FAA moves to fire two LaGuardia controllers for leaving early before fatal crash
en.summary: FAA moves to fire LaGuardia controllers; early leave preceded fatal runway collision killing two pilots.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has initiated termination proceedings against two air traffic controllers at New York LaGuardia Airport (LGA). According to findings, the controllers left work approximately one hour early on the night of a deadly runway collision that resulted in the deaths of two pilots and injuries to dozens more.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the controllers departed prior to the end of their scheduled shifts on March 22, 2026. At the time, airport operations were disrupted by thunderstorms and delays, forcing controllers to manage more than double the volume of traffic that had originally been scheduled. Consequently, the two controllers remaining in the tower were left working without additional backup support during a period of unusually heavy traffic.

The fatal collision occurred at 23:37 local time. Air Canada Express Flight 8646, a CRJ900 operated by Jazz Aviation, was landing on Runway 4 following a flight from Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL) when it collided with an airport fire truck that had been cleared to cross the runway. The fire truck was responding to a separate aircraft emergency. According to the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), the captain and first officer of the CRJ900 were killed, while 39 people were transported to hospitals, including six who suffered serious injuries.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy expressed strong disapproval regarding the issue, stating that the government will not tolerate fraud and will take action against employees who take advantage of taxpayers and increase the workload on their colleagues. Leaving before a shift ends is known among controllers as an "early shove," which FAA officials consider a form of timecard fraud. The National Air Traffic Controllers Association (NATCA) noted it is discussing allegations of widespread timecard and leave fraud with FAA leadership, while also pointing to the challenging staffing conditions under which controllers routinely operate.

zh.title: 菲律賓空軍接收最後七架黑鷹直升機 機隊達47架成全球最大S-70i營運者
zh.summary: 菲律賓空軍接收最後7架S-70i直升機，完成交付後機隊達47架成全球最大。
body: 菲律賓空軍於2026年8月26日在位於帕賽市的耶穌·維拉摩爾上校空軍基地（Colonel Jesus Villamor Air Base）舉行交機儀式，正式接收最後7架S-70i黑鷹（Black Hawk）直升機。菲律賓空軍司令阿瑟·科爾杜拉（Arthur M. Cordura）中將出席並擔任主禮嘉賓。
本次7架直升機的交付，完成了向洛克希德·馬丁（Lockheed Martin）旗下波蘭子公司PZL Mielec訂購32架S-70i直升機的合約。該項於2022年簽署的第二次採購合約金額約為320億披索（約5.71億美元），交付工作自2024年起分階段進行，包括2024年交付10架、2025年交付10架、2026年1月交付5架，以及本次交付的最終7架。
在接收最終批次直升機後，菲律賓空軍的S-70i直升機隊總規模達到47架，成為全球最大的S-70i機型營運者。菲律賓空軍最初於2019年簽署第一份採購合約，以約115億披索（約2.05億美元）購買16架S-70i直升機，該批次除了1架於2021年在塔拉克省卡帕斯墜毀外，其餘15架均在持續服役中。
這項採購案隸屬於第10349號共和國法案下的修訂版菲律賓武裝部隊現代化計畫「Horizon 2」階段。S-70i為中型通用直升機，可搭載約16名全副武裝士兵或20名人員，單次飛行續航時間約2.5小時。新機隊正全面取代服役數十年的UH-1H休伊（Huey）直升機，以執行人員運輸、搜索救援、醫療後送與災害應變等多項任務。

en.title: Philippine Air Force Accepts Final 7 S-70i Black Hawks, Completing 32-Unit Order
en.summary: Philippine Air Force accepts final seven S-70i Black Hawks in Pasay City, expanding fleet to 47 aircraft.
body: The Philippine Air Force (PAF) has formally accepted its final seven S-70i Black Hawk helicopters during a ceremony held at Colonel Jesus Villamor Air Base in Pasay City on August 26, 2026. PAF Commanding General Lieutenant General Arthur M. Cordura attended the event as the guest of honor for the official handover.

The delivery completes a 32-aircraft acquisition contract signed in 2022 with Lockheed Martin's Polish subsidiary PZL Mielec, valued at approximately PHP 32 billion (US$571 million). Deliveries under this second agreement arrived in multiple phases, starting with 10 units in 2024, followed by another 10 in 2025, five in January 2026, and the final seven on August 26, 2026.

With the arrival of the final seven aircraft, the PAF's total S-70i Black Hawk fleet has grown to 47 units, making the Philippines the largest operator of the S-70i variant globally. The PAF previously acquired 16 S-70i helicopters under a 2019 contract worth PHP 11.5 billion (US$205 million), of which 15 remain operational after one aircraft was lost in a 2021 crash in Capas, Tarlac.

The helicopter acquisition is part of Horizon 2 of the Revised Armed Forces of the Philippines Modernization Program under Republic Act No. 10349. The S-70i is a medium-lift utility helicopter capable of carrying approximately 16 fully armed troops or 20 personnel with an endurance of roughly two and a half hours per flight. The fleet is replacing older UH-1H Huey helicopters for troop transport, search and rescue, aeromedical evacuation, and disaster response operations across the archipelago.

zh.title: 澳洲航空提前於2028年退役A380客機並商討替代機隊訂單
zh.summary: 澳洲航空將A380退役時間提前至2028年；並與空中巴士及波音商討替代機型
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）於2026年8月26日確認，將提前退役旗下的空中巴士A380（Airbus A380）客機機隊。該公司原本預計將A380營運至至少2032財政年度，如今已決定將該機型的退役時間提早至2028年執行。
這項退役時程的調整是在雪梨總部舉辦的2026財政年度業績簡報會上公布。澳洲航空表示，2026年早些時候中東爆發衝突導致航空燃油價格飆升，對營運A380這類四引擎老舊機型的成本造成顯著衝擊。該公司估算燃油危機帶來的整體影響原本可能高達6.1億澳元，但經由採取相關緩和措施後，已成功將該影響控制降至4.2億澳元。

為了補足A380退役後的運量需求，澳洲航空規劃與空中巴士及波音（Boeing）展開談判，預計將部分尚未執行的購買權轉換為確認訂單，不過目前未透露具體數量。澳洲航空目前已訂購12架「日出計畫」（Project Sunrise）專用的超長程A350-1000客機，預計自2027年起連結澳洲東岸至倫敦與紐約；同時該公司亦透過「費許計畫」（Project Fysh）訂購了12架標準型A350-1000、8架波音787-10以及4架波音787-9客機，用於替換既有的A330機隊。
在載客能力方面，澳洲航空現有的A380客機配備高達438個座位，而未來預計引進的替代機型（不論是A350-1000或波音787）載客量將減半。例如現行的波音787-9客機配置為236個座位，而超長程A350客機載客量則為最多238人。

en.title: Qantas to Retire Airbus A380 Fleet Early in 2028 and Negotiate Replacement Orders
en.summary: Qantas will retire its Airbus A380 fleet in 2028 and negotiate replacement orders with manufacturers.
body: Qantas confirmed on August 26, 2026, that it will retire its Airbus A380 fleet earlier than originally planned. Although the double-deck aircraft were previously expected to remain in active service until at least fiscal year 2032, the airline has decided to bring the retirement schedule forward to 2028.

The announcement was made during the presentation of the carrier's FY26 financial results at its headquarters in Sydney. Airline management cited significant spikes in jet fuel prices following conflict in the Middle East earlier in 2026, which heavily impacted the operational economics of four-engined aircraft. Qantas estimated that the total financial impact of the fuel crisis could have reached AU$610 million, but mitigation measures helped lower the final impact to AU$420 million.

To address its future widebody requirements, Qantas stated that it will enter formal negotiations with Airbus and Boeing to convert existing purchase options into firm orders, though specific numbers were not disclosed. The carrier already has orders for 12 ultra-long-range A350-1000 aircraft for its "Project Sunrise" routes connecting eastern Australia to London and New York starting in late 2027. In addition, under "Project Fysh," Qantas has ordered 12 standard A350-1000s, eight Boeing 787-10s, and four Boeing 787-9s to replace its aging A330 fleet.

The transition will significantly alter per-aircraft passenger capacity across the long-haul fleet. Qantas' current A380 fleet is configured to seat up to 438 passengers, whereas replacement twin-engine widebodies will carry roughly half that capacity. For instance, the airline's Boeing 787-9s carry 236 passengers and the Project Sunrise A350-1000ULR aircraft will seat up to 238 passengers.

zh.title: 美國運輸部與FAA宣布啟動BEYOND計畫第二階段 擴大無人機空域整合
zh.summary: 美國FAA啟動BEYOND計畫第二階段；擬增選最多八個主導單位擴大無人機測試
body: 美國運輸部長肖恩·達菲（Sean P. Duffy）於2026年8月27日宣布，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）正式啟動BEYOND計畫第二階段，以進一步推動無人機系統整合至美國國家空域系統（NAS）。該計畫授權依據為《2024年FAA授權法案》第920條，旨在深化無人機在超視距（BVLOS）營運及公共安全任務等複雜空域環境中的應用。
FAA預計將選出最多八個額外的州、地方、部落及領地單位作為主導參與者，使計畫規模擴大一倍。根據官方資料，在BEYOND計畫第一階段期間，參與單位累計記錄超過7萬架次飛行，其中包括逾4萬8,000架次超視距作業，為制定標準化監管規範提供關鍵數據。

en.title: US DOT and FAA Launch Phase 2 of BEYOND Program to Expand Drone Integration
en.summary: The FAA launches BEYOND Phase 2 to double participant entities and expand drone airspace integration.
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced on August 27, 2026, that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is launching Phase 2 of the BEYOND program. Authorized under Section 920 of the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024, the initiative aims to expand the integration of unmanned aircraft systems into the national airspace system and address operational challenges in beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) operations and public safety missions.

Under Phase 2, the FAA plans to double the program's scope by selecting up to eight additional state, local, tribal, and territorial entities as lead participants. During BEYOND Phase 1, participants logged over 70,000 flights, including more than 48,000 BVLOS operations, generating operational data to support regulatory standards.

zh.title: 日本公開川崎EC-2電波干擾機 衍生自C-2運輸機機體
zh.summary: 日本公開川崎EC-2視外電波干擾機；採用C-2機體與突出鼻錐設計
body: 日本於2026年正式公開川崎EC-2視外電波干擾機（EC-2 standoff jammer）。該型電子作戰機為川崎重工（Kawasaki Aerospace Company）產製C-2軍用運輸機的最新衍生型號，研發改裝計畫於2021年啟動，首架改裝完成的機體於2026年3月公開亮相。
EC-2型機是以機號68-1203的C-2運輸機進行改裝。該機體最初於2016年出廠，為生產線上的第三架C-2運輸機。改裝後的EC-2外觀具備顯著特徵，包括巨大的突出鼻錐罩，以及於機背（含主翼上方機身區段）安裝的兩處大型整流罩與後機身兩側的兩處整流罩，並配置J/ALQ-5電子對抗系統。
在作戰角色方面，EC-2的主要任務是在防空威脅射程之外，針對敵方於電磁頻譜上的行動進行電波干擾與壓制。採用大型運輸機作為改裝平台，能解決戰鬥機在電力供應與散熱管理上的限制。EC-2具備82,900磅的酬載能力，較舊款川崎C-1運輸機的26,200磅酬載有顯著提升。
川崎C-2為雙發動機中型運輸機，配備通用電氣（General Electric）CF6發動機，最初用於取代舊型的川崎C-1。截至2026年，該系列機型累計已交付21架，包含17架C-2標準運輸機、3架RC-2電子情報與信號情報（ELINT/SIGINT）偵察機，以及1架最新完成改裝的EC-2視外電波干擾機。

en.title: Japan Unveils Kawasaki EC-2 Standoff Electronic Warfare Aircraft
en.summary: Japan has revealed the Kawasaki EC-2 standoff electronic warfare aircraft based on the C-2 airframe.
body: Japan has officially unveiled the Kawasaki EC-2 standoff jammer electronic warfare aircraft in 2026. The new aircraft represents the latest specialized variant of the Kawasaki C-2 military airlifter produced by Japan's Kawasaki Aerospace Company. Development work on the standoff electronic warfare conversion program initially began in 2021, with the modified airframe first appearing publicly in March 2026.

The EC-2 platform is converted from a standard C-2 airframe registered as 68-1203, which was originally produced in 2016 as the third aircraft off the C-2 assembly line. The modified airframe features distinct exterior additions, including a prominent bulged nose cone, two large dorsal flarings with one positioned over the wingbox, and two additional flarings on the sides of the aft fuselage to accommodate electronic warfare equipment such as the J/ALQ-5 system.

In operational deployment, the primary mission of the EC-2 is to disrupt adversary operations across the electromagnetic spectrum while operating from standoff ranges outside the reach of enemy air defense systems. Utilizing a cargo aircraft platform provides significant operational advantages over fighter jets, particularly regarding electrical power generation capacity and thermal management requirements necessary for high-powered electronic jamming systems. The aircraft possesses a payload capacity of 82,900 pounds, compared to 26,200 pounds on the older Kawasaki C-1.

The baseline Kawasaki C-2 is a mid-sized, twin-engine transport aircraft powered by General Electric CF6 turbofans, designed to replace Japan's aging fleet of Kawasaki C-1 airlifters. As of 2026, a total of 21 C-2 family airframes have been delivered to service. This fleet consists of 17 standard C-2 transport aircraft, 3 RC-2 electronic intelligence and signals intelligence (ELINT/SIGINT) variants, and the single newly converted EC-2 standoff jammer aircraft.
